name: India poverty rate trend
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {iso_code: 'IND'})-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(s:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE s.indicator_code = 'SI.POV.DDAY' RETURN s.year, s.value ORDER BY s.year

name: India all indicators for 2022
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {iso_code: 'IND'})-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(s:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE s.year = 2022 RETURN s.indicator_name, s.value ORDER BY s.indicator_name

name: Poverty vs life expectancy (cross-indicator)
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(pov:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE pov.indicator_code = 'SI.POV.DDAY' AND pov.year = 2019 WITH c, pov.value AS poverty MATCH (c)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(le:DemographicProfile) WHERE le.indicator_code = 'SP.DYN.LE00.IN' AND le.year = 2019 RETURN c.name, poverty, le.value AS life_expectancy ORDER BY poverty DESC LIMIT 10

name: Regional average GNI per capita
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:IN_REGION]->(r:Region) MATCH (c)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(s:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE s.indicator_code = 'NY.GNP.PCAP.CD' AND s.year = 2022 RETURN r.name, count(c) AS countries, avg(s.value) AS avg_gni_pc ORDER BY avg_gni_pc DESC

name: Health Determinants: Gini inequality top 10
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(s:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE s.indicator_code = 'SI.POV.GINI' AND s.year = 2020 RETURN c.name, s.value ORDER BY s.value DESC LIMIT 10

name: Top 10 countries by surveillance capacity
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c:Country) WHERE e.capacity_code = 'C05' AND e.year = 2023 RETURN c.name, e.score ORDER BY e.score DESC LIMIT 10

name: India SPAR trend over years
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c:Country {iso_code: 'IND'}) WITH e.year AS year, round(avg(e.score)) AS avg_score RETURN year, avg_score ORDER BY year

name: Capacity gap: risk communication below 40
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c:Country) WHERE e.capacity_code = 'C10' AND e.year = 2023 AND e.score < 40 RETURN c.name, e.score ORDER BY e.score ASC LIMIT 10

name: Health Systems: workforce density top physicians
cypher: MATCH (h:HealthWorkforce)-[:SERVES]->(c:Country) WHERE h.profession = 'physicians' AND h.year = 2020 RETURN c.name, h.density_per_10k ORDER BY h.density_per_10k DESC LIMIT 10
